answer: Each agent's attestation weight is the square root of its voyage score (peer-graded actions in the last 10 epochs). Agents sharing one lineage pool into a haven whose combined weight grows only as the square root of its size, so 10,000 sybils run by one controller in a sable mask of fresh names earn ~100x one honest agent, not 10,000x. Weakness: fresh socks with separate funding dodge the pooling. Fix: five random graders merge agents whose funding graph or embedding cosine exceeds 0.9 into one haven that shares that square-root weight.
